notes.title: Goblin.Life Demo Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39541942/ad1feb3d7a10acc86c6d03909348b07f25f4c11f.png

Come play the Goblin.Life Demo and discover what Imagination with Friends can be about. 

- Brush 3D tiles into inherently multiplayer worlds with the Imagination editor.
- Play your favorite tabletop games on real-time updatable multiplayer maps. Leave a lasting impression with that next fireball.
- Carve astral glyphs to add interactive, highly moddable elements to your .Goblin saves until they become .Goblin Games
- Glyphs control everything; spawning Goblins(AI), controlling the weather, creating portals to other realms. Very powerful stuff!
- Inherently multiplayer and linkable, copy and paste from the main menu to share links to your friends.
- Upload your creations via GitHub or the Steam workshop in the Full Version to create permanent URLs to your .Goblin Games.


# WHEN ? 
February the 1st, 2021 - Noon PST

# WHAT ?
Goblin.Life Demo is available for everyone! Free!
